_comment: Verified root glosses: short verbatim quotations from Penrice (1873), each with its page, cross-checked against Lane's Lexicon by a second reader. Hand-entered records only; scripts/build-root-glosses.mjs validates every record (see docs/root-glosses.md for the transcription rules) and fails the build on any that is incomplete. A record here means the TRANSCRIPTION was checked, not that the English is the meaning: every gloss renders with the Nuanced (~) label. Empty until the first batch is transcribed.
